corrections.issue: Wrong speaker and shaky dating. The carry-unwind remark is made by the host (Niels Kaastrup-Larsen), who says he compared his own UCITS fund with a peer group and that Beer 'could be right' about more carry in some funds, citing an August unwind a couple of years earlier (he cannot recall 2023 or 2024). The July 2026 carry link is Beer's hypothesis in C05, not Roble's finding.
corrections.fix: Niels Kaastrup-Larsen: after comparing his UCITS fund with peers he thinks Beer may be right that some UCITS CTAs run more non-trend carry, which would make them differ from pure trend during a carry unwind like the August unwind a couple of years earlier; this could explain part of the July 2026 divergence.

completeness_estimate: 0.80 - the first reader caught the main CTA-index, crisis-alpha, leverage and survivorship arguments; it missed several supporting mechanisms and data points (July 2026 index divergence, August index numbers, Beer's handcuffs rationale, Roble's disagreement on adding markets, mutual-fund flow mistiming, index construction method) and mis-attributed one speaker.
